local_evidence: Existing five-TRAIN-example CPU INT8 checks do not establish that 1% continual updates are erased by quantization; their extension remains closed.
reason: Low-bit frozen backbones with separate high-precision low-rank adaptation and quantization-aware initialization/merging have direct precedents. A new CL functional hypothesis and a byte-matched comparison are missing.
future_evaluation_constraint: Give strong baselines the same quantization opportunity; count residuals, scales, unquantized components and actual runtime memory. Extra FP16 residual capacity cannot itself establish protection of learned updates.
